summary: Stevanato Group S.p.A. filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its unaudited interim report for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, equivalent to a US quarterly report on Form 10-Q for a foreign private issuer. The filing contains interim condensed consolidated financial statements, management's discussion and analysis of financial condition and results of operations, market-risk disclosure, controls and procedures, legal proceedings and risk factors. No transaction, ownership change, capital return, board recommendation or advisor mandate is disclosed. No special-situation angle; monitor ordinary earnings and guidance trends only.
